items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This update resolves critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to arbitrary code execution, privilege escalation, and security feature bypass. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for these issues.

items.title: Amasty patches 25 Magento extensions, 1 critical
items.summary: Amasty issued a massive security release for 25 extensions, with one critical vulnerability that can lead to remote code execution. Sansec Shield already blocks the critical issues.

items.title: Unauthenticated file upload in Amasty Order Attributes for Magento
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, opening the door to remote code execution.

items.title: Critical vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer for Magento
items.summary: Sansec discovered an unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer, a popular Magento extension, which can lead to remote code execution via a crafted cookie. Mirasvit released a patched version 1.11.12.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce
items.summary: This bulletin fixes 15 CVEs in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source, including critical Stored XSS (CVE-2026-34686) leading to arbitrary code execution and Path Traversal (CVE-2026-34653) leading to arbitrary file system write.

items.title: Critical Security Update: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This critical security update addresses multiple vulnerabilities that could allow attackers to bypass security mechanisms, gain escalated privileges, execute unauthorized malicious code, and compromise store data. Adobe recommends applying patches as quickly as possible.

items.title: PolyShell: unrestricted file upload in Magento and Adobe Commerce
items.summary: Sansec discovered PolyShell, a critical flaw in Magento's REST API that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload executable files by disguising code as an image. While Magento 2.4.9 contains a fix, older supported versions remain vulnerable.
